chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him) to 'Abdullah ibn al-'Abbas

key_terms.إِمَامُ عَلِيٍّ: Imam Ali, the first Imam in Shia Islam and fourth Caliph in Sunni Islam
key_terms.ابْنِ الْعَبَّاسِ: Ibn al-Abbas, referring to the son of Abdullah ibn Abbas, a cousin of the Prophet and renowned Quranic exegete
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abdullah, a common male name meaning 'Servant of God'

ai.seo_question: Who was the recipient of Imam Ali's letter in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a significant epistle from Imam Ali (AS) to Abdullah ibn al-Abbas, highlighting the transmission of esoteric and exoteric knowledge from the Ahl al-Bayt to the most learned of the Companions. It underscores the scholarly continuity between the Prophet’s household and the early Islamic elite, framing the letter as a source of authoritative guidance during a pivotal era of Islamic history.
